title: Self-organized Agents: A LLM Multi-Agent Framework toward Ultra Large-Scale Code Generation and Optimization
removal_reason: Claims ultra-large-scale code generation, but evaluation is mainly HumanEval-style function generation and code-size accounting; evidence does not support the broad scalability claim.

title: A Multi-agent Large Language Model Framework to Automatically Assess Performance of a Clinical AI Triage Tool
removal_reason: Useful clinical report-extraction ensemble, but the 'agents' are independent LLM labelers with consensus; little multi-agent mechanism beyond voting.

title: SciAgents: Automating Scientific Discovery through Multi-Agent Intelligent Graph Reasoning
removal_reason: Primarily case-study/demo evidence for scientific discovery, with broad claims about surpassing human-driven research but no controlled baselines or rigorous validation.

title: A Multi-Agent LLM Defense Pipeline Against Prompt Injection Attacks
removal_reason: Defense claims 100% prompt-injection mitigation on a small handcrafted 55-attack mostly single-turn dataset; broad safety claims are not supported by robust agent benchmarks.
